attempts.summary: Configured a persistent ufw firewall on node1: SSH (22/tcp) allowed from anywhere, 9000/tcp allowed only from node2 (10.100.49.11), and 9000/tcp rejected from all other sources (verified against node3). ufw is enabled at boot via systemd. Also ran the mandatory restart-evidence protocol on all three nodes, restarting one at a time, confirming changed boot identity, and re-verifying firewall behavior after each restart.
